findings.detail: README references absent requirements.txt and --img1/--img2 flags. Main has no argument parser and always reads before.jpg/after.jpg.
pHash uses Pillow default imagehash transform; no alpha/ICC/orientation, full animation/page or exact byte/pixel identity confirmation.

SSIM reads grayscale then stretches both images to the minimum width/height independently. RGB/alpha differences, original dimensions and aspect ratio are not retained. Failed imread is dereferenced via .shape; tiny images are not preflighted.
ORB reports raw count of cross-checked matches, no distance admission, geometric model or original pixel confirmation. No descriptors returns numeric0, including textureless identical images.
No source mutation/generation cancellation, budget, cache identity, grouping, file-management operations or resource isolation.

scope: Every file in complete pinned tree fully read and Gitblob verified. Runtime counterexamples pending; no third-party dependency source audit or general matcher precision proof.
